scripts.build:all: npm run build:html-mobile && npm run build:html-kiosk && npm run build:apks
scripts.build:html-mobile: vite build --config vite.standalone.config.ts && mkdir -p dist-mobile && cp -r dist/mobile.html dist/assets dist-mobile/ && cp dist-mobile/mobile.html dist/index.html
scripts.build:html-kiosk: vite build --config vite.standalone.config.ts && mkdir -p dist-kiosk && cp -r dist/kiosk.html dist/assets dist-kiosk/ && cp dist-kiosk/kiosk.html dist/index.html
scripts.build:apk-mobile: cp capacitor.mobile.config.json capacitor.config.json && npm run build:html-mobile && npx cap sync android && cd android && chmod +x gradlew && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cd .. && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk release/GateFlame-Mobile.apk
scripts.build:apk-kiosk: cp capacitor.kiosk.config.json capacitor.config.json && npm run build:html-kiosk && npx cap sync android && cd android && chmod +x gradlew && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cd .. && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk release/GateFlame-Kiosk.apk
scripts.package:release: mkdir -p release && npm run build:html-mobile && npm run build:html-kiosk && tar -czvf release/GateFlame-Complete-Package.tar.gz dist-mobile dist-kiosk
scripts.build:apks: npm run build:apk-mobile && npm run build:apk-kiosk
